2. The service

Getnera is software that lets businesses manage WhatsApp conversations, leads and follow-ups, including AI-assisted replies and approved message templates. We may improve or change features over time.

3. Your account

You must give accurate information, keep login details safe, and are responsible for what happens under your account, including your team members' actions.

4. WhatsApp and Meta rules

Getnera uses the WhatsApp Business Platform provided by Meta. You must follow the WhatsApp Business Policy, the WhatsApp Commerce Policy and Meta's terms. In particular, you must:

  • message only people who have given you their number and agreed to hear from you on WhatsApp;
  • honour opt-out requests promptly;
  • not send spam, illegal content, or content WhatsApp prohibits.

Meta may limit, suspend or ban a WhatsApp number or account for policy breaches. We are not responsible for Meta's decisions, but we will help where we can.

5. Your data

You own the data you and your customers put into Getnera. You give us permission to process it only to provide the service, as described in our Privacy Policy. You are responsible for having a lawful basis, such as consent, for the customer data you upload or collect.

6. AI features

AI-generated replies are suggestions based on the information you provide. They may be wrong. You are responsible for the content you send and for reviewing AI settings and knowledge base content.

7. Fees

Paid plans are billed as shown at sign-up or in your order. WhatsApp conversation charges set by Meta may apply in addition. Fees are exclusive of GST, which is charged as applicable. Unless stated otherwise, fees already paid are not refundable.
